title: IoTKit MQTT Output Adapter v1 status payload
description: Payload published to iotkit/v1/edge-node/{edge-node-id}/status with QoS 1 and retain. Heartbeats carry online or degraded. offline comes either from IoTKit at graceful shutdown (with uptime_ms and, when trusted, unix_epoch_ms) or from the Broker's Will (both null).

uptime_ms.description: Milliseconds since the IoTKit process started (monotonic clock).

unix_epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock Unix epoch milliseconds, or null while IoTKit cannot vouch for its clock.

uptime_ms.description: Milliseconds since the IoTKit process started (monotonic clock).

unix_epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock Unix epoch milliseconds, or null while IoTKit cannot vouch for its clock.

offline-will.description: Published by the Broker on abnormal disconnect. Both times are null because IoTKit did not observe the disconnect.
